_why: Governance refusals are user- and model-visible contract wording, the managed enterprise policy is an admin-provisioned data surface, and the usage ledger is a local-only file. All three are pinned so neither the safety list, the organization-policy wording, nor the telemetry event surface can drift silently.

messages.organizationDisabled: Computer Use is blocked by your organization's policy.
messages.organizationBlockedApp: Computer Use is blocked from using the app '{app}' by your organization's policy.
messages.safetyForbiddenApp: Computer Use is not allowed to use the app '{app}' for safety reasons.
messages.managedUnreadable: Computer Use managed policy is unreadable; it is blocked until the policy file is repaired.
